## Intro

Lauterbrunnen has pretty much everything that makes Switzerland special, all in one place. Marvel at natural spectacles against an alpine backdrop. Stroll through picture-postcard villages. Take Switzerland’s most beautiful hiking and winter sports areas by storm. And experience the UNESCO World Heritage Jungfrau-Aletsch from up close.

## Lauterbrunnen at a glance

### This is Lauterbrunnen

Lauterbrunnen can be found in a valley of dramatic beauty between [Interlaken](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/interlaken/) and the [Jungfrau Massif](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/lauterbrunnen/~/link.%20aspx?_id=AC3015BA947E46D2B43247BFE5CB9F7D&_z=z). You’d be hard pressed to find anywhere that feels as much like the [Swiss Alps](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/unesco-world-heritage-swiss-alps-jungfrau-aletsch/).

### Discover Lauterbrunnen

One way to start your day could be with a stroll through the village, against the backdrop of the [Staubbach Falls](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/staubbach-falls-free-falling-waters-with-a-mist-of-spray/). Then the best photo spot can be found in the car-free postcard village [Wengen](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/wengen/). Depending on what takes your fancy at the time, either take the cogwheel railway to [Kleine Scheidegg](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/kleine-scheidegg-1/) or the cable car to [Mürren](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/lauterbrunnen/~/link.%20aspx?_id=200CF3C7FC694ECE9DC29BB49ED343AA&_z=z). The trip up to the [Männlichen](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/maennlichen/) is worth the ride alone – on the roof of the cable car.

### Waterfalls in Lauterbrunnen

The village gets its name – Lauter Brunnen (loud springs) – from the 72 waterfalls that can be found there. Its landmark is the [Staubbachfall](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/staubbach-falls-free-falling-waters-with-a-mist-of-spray/): see how it cascades 300 metres over the vertical rock face. The [Mürrenbachfall](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/the-muerrenbachfall/), which plunges 750 meters into the depths in five cascades, is a mighty sight. The [Trümmelbachfälle](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/truemmelbach-falls/) also lets you feel the tremendous energy of the water: the glacier water thunders through a labyrinth of rocks inside the mountain.

### Wengen and Mürren

Enjoy the peace and quiet as well as the views available in the two car-free mountain villages that belong to the municipality of Lauterbrunnen. Wengen is on the sunny side and on the route to [Grindelwald](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/grindelwald/). From [Mürren](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/muerren/) the cable car takes you up to [Schilthorn](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/schilthorn/) with its [revolving restaurant Piz Gloria](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/360-restaurant-piz-gloria/). But before all that, why not take a selfie – with the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau in the background?

### Around Lauterbrunnen

Lauterbrunnen is the starting point for the most well-known excursion destinations in the [Jungfrau Region](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/the-jungfrau-region/). Thanks to the well-developed rail network, you can easily get from one mountain highlight to the next. Tip: take enough time to explore the unique nature around Lauterbrunnen at your own pace – there is so much to experience.

### Experience Lauterbrunnen for less

The [Swiss Travel Pass](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/transport-accommodation/tickets-public-transport/swiss-travel-pass/), the Jungfrau Travel Pass and the [Bernese Oberland Pass](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/transport-accommodation/tickets-public-transport/regional-passes/berner-oberland-pass/) all give you free travel on railways, buses and many cable cars and mountain railways around Lauterbrunnen. Accommodation can be found for less at hostels, [youth hostels](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/other-types-of-accommodations/youth-hostels/) and campsites. Hundreds of marked hiking paths with panoramic views and barbecue areas offer you a free way of having fun.
